name: wechatpy-replay-safe-callback-consumption
instr:
wechatpy cannot consume authenticated WeChat callbacks exactly once, recognize retries, or recover from interrupted processing. Add replay protection for official-account, Work, component, payment-v2 result and refund, and payment-v3 notifications through a shared SessionStorage lifecycle. Keep existing entry-point behavior unless replay-aware consumption is requested.

Make admission, completion, release, lease expiry, retention, ownership enforcement, and exact outcome preservation atomic and consistent across MemoryStorage, RedisStorage, and MemcachedStorage. ClaimStatus is an Enum. Stale owners raise CallbackOwnershipError, an Exception carrying identity and owner_token. CallbackCoordinator exposes begin(self, identity), complete(self, claim, outcome=None), and release(self, claim). SessionStorage exposes claim_callback(self, identity, owner_token, ttl), complete_callback(self, identity, owner_token, outcome, ttl), release_callback(self, identity, owner_token), and get_callback(self, identity).

Authenticated consumers derive deterministic protocol-scoped identities from validated data. Use distinct namespaces for merchant-scoped payment-v2 transaction identities and decrypted payment-v2 refund identities. Admit only validated deliveries. Completed duplicates return recorded outcomes without repeated processing or component side effects. Authentication failures create no claim and retain established exceptions. Non-replay entry points preserve parsing, decryption, concret
